description:
You are the administrator for the Urban Electronics store. Several configuration issues have been reported that need immediate fixing:

1. Product Issue: The 'Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra' has disappeared from the catalog. It appears to be unpublished. Find it and publish it so customers can buy it.
2. Store Configuration: The store contact email for 'Urban Electronics' has a typo ('stoer@urbanelectronics.com'). Correct it to 'store@urbanelectronics.com'.
3. Promotion Issue: The 'Electronics 15% Off' promotion stopped working. Its end date was set incorrectly to the past. Update the end date to December 31, 2025.
4. User Access: Customer 'mikewilson' (email: mike.wilson@example.com) is complaining they cannot log in. Their account seems to be blocked. Unblock their account.

All fixes must be applied via the Drupal Commerce admin interface.
